page.title: Component Studio
page.descLead: {count} reusable components, picked from 80+ local legacy front-end projects, decoupled from business logic and rewritten with zero dependencies, grouped into {groups} capability areas.
page.descTail: All demo data is neutral fictional placeholder content with no original sensitive information.

scanempty.name: ScanEmpty
scanempty.title: Scanning empty state
scanempty.desc: A large-screen empty-state scanning animation built with pure CSS/SVG — no chart library required, usable in any container.
scanempty.subText: No abnormal events in the last 24 hours

autoscroll.name: AutoScrollList
autoscroll.title: Seamless scrolling list
autoscroll.desc: Content taller than the container scrolls vertically in a loop automatically and pauses on hover; the offset is driven by a CSS variable, with no state jitter.

board.name: DraggableBoard
board.title: Orchestratable board
board.desc: Percentage positioning + collision detection + unified pointer events; with editing on, cards can be dragged/resized, and illegal drops snap back.

axisbreak.name: AxisBreakBar
axisbreak.title: Axis-break bar chart
axisbreak.desc: Folds away blank ranges when high and low values differ wildly; drag horizontally on the chart to choose the Y range to fold.

regionmap.name: SvgRegionMap
regionmap.title: Data-driven region map
regionmap.desc: viewBox-based pure SVG with proportional scaling, layered dots (base map / region blocks / bubbles), and region click callbacks.

adapttable.name: AdaptTable
adapttable.title: Large-screen adaptive table
adapttable.desc: Column widths split evenly by percentage, draggable column width / row height, and automatic marquee for overlong cell content.

rulebuilder.name: RuleBuilder
rulebuilder.title: Visual condition builder
rulebuilder.desc: AND/OR nested groups + a recursive tree of leaf conditions, with operators switching automatically by field type; outputs structured JSON.

jsondiff.name: JsonDiff
jsondiff.title: Structured object diff
jsondiff.desc: A structural diff rather than a text diff: accurately marks added / removed / changed / unchanged, with paths at a glance.

annotator.name: ImageAnnotator
annotator.title: Image annotation with zoom & pan
annotator.desc: Wheel zoom, drag pan; annotation anchors are stored in normalized coordinates, so they never drift after zoom/pan.

dynform.name: DynamicForm
dynform.title: Schema-driven dynamic form
dynform.desc: One field schema is one UI; supports many common field types plus required-field validation.

orgtree.name: OrgTree
orgtree.title: Hierarchical org tree
orgtree.desc: A hierarchical tree of any depth that expands/collapses level by level, with single-select search.

scanreport.name: ScanReport
scanreport.title: Security scan report card
scanreport.desc: Renders a structured scan report as a severity distribution + detail list, able to carry any checklist: vulnerabilities, reviews, inspections, etc.

anchornav.name: AnchorNav
anchornav.title: Anchor scroll navigation
anchornav.desc: Sticky left-hand table of contents + right-hand content area; click to smooth-scroll, with the current section auto-highlighted while scrolling (rAF-throttled).

pagetabs.name: PageTabs
pagetabs.title: Multi-tab workspace
pagetabs.desc: Router-style tab bar: switchable, closable, and creatable; the content area is provided by the current tab's render.

treetable.name: TreeTable
treetable.title: Tree table + ancestor-preserving search
treetable.desc: Expands level by level; searching by name automatically keeps and expands the parents of matched descendants, never losing context.

highlighter.name: Highlighter
highlighter.title: Keyword highlighting
highlighter.desc: Wraps text fragments matching the keyword in <mark>; pure-function splitting, embeddable in any list or table cell.

editabletable.name: EditableTable
editabletable.title: Inline-editable table
editabletable.desc: Click "Edit" to switch the whole row to inputs/dropdowns; saving writes back, canceling restores the initial values.

draglayout.name: DragLayout
draglayout.title: Free drag-and-resize layout
draglayout.desc: Cards are positioned by percentage and can be dragged to move or corner-dragged to resize, always constrained to the container; ideal for lightweight low-code dashboards.

gauge.name: CanvasGauge
gauge.title: Canvas gauge
gauge.desc: Zero-dependency Canvas gauge: rAF easing to the target value, high-DPI, container-adaptive.

carousel3d.name: CardCarousel3D
carousel3d.title: 3D card carousel
carousel3d.desc: Gesture direction detection (>45° yields to vertical scrolling); cards switch with Z-axis depth and rotation by relative position.

frameplayer.name: FramePlayer
frameplayer.title: Frame sequence player
frameplayer.desc: Loops through a set of "frames" by fps, with play/pause, frame stepping, and progress dragging; a frame can be any node.

contextmenu.name: ContextMenu
contextmenu.title: Context menu
contextmenu.desc: Right-click inside the wrapped area to open the menu; clicking anywhere or scrolling closes it.

errorboundary.name: ErrorBoundary
errorboundary.title: Error boundary
errorboundary.desc: Catches render-phase exceptions in the subtree, shows a fallback UI, and supports retry.

fullscreen.name: Fullscreen
fullscreen.title: Fullscreen container
fullscreen.desc: Calls the Fullscreen API on a given area and syncs the current fullscreen state.

report.title: Dependency & configuration inspection report
report.f1Title: Dependency with a known high-risk vulnerability
report.f1Detail: A dependency version is below the security baseline; an upgrade is recommended.
report.f2Detail: Use environment variables or a secrets manager instead.
report.f4Title: Debug port exposed to the internet
report.f4Detail: Opening it to the intranet only is recommended.

anchor.overviewText: This area demonstrates anchor scrolling: click an item in the left directory and the content area smooth-scrolls to the matching section.
anchor.metricText: While scrolling, the left directory automatically highlights the currently visible section (throttled to once per frame).
anchor.usageText: Great for long documents, help centers, configuration notes, and any page needing directory navigation.
anchor.faqText: The directory and content are anchored via id, with no extra state syncing needed.

drag.card1Text: Drag the title to move, drag the bottom-right corner to resize
drag.card2Text: Drops are automatically constrained to the container

ui.ctxHint: Right-click this area to open the menu
ui.boomHint: Click the button to make the subtree throw; the error boundary will catch it and support retry.
ui.fullscreenHint: Click the "Fullscreen" button at the top right (may be restricted in a sandbox)
